templates.default_objective: Scale multi-node mesh capacity, evaluate developer velocity, and streamline onboarding.

chimera_rounds.title: DAG Bottleneck & Flow Analysis
chimera_rounds.goal: Profile task execution graphs, identify serialization bottlenecks, and measure agent latency.

chimera_rounds.title: Multi-Node Mesh Capacity Planning
chimera_rounds.goal: Model workload distribution across Tailscale fleet nodes and evaluate memory headroom scaling.

chimera_rounds.title: Operator HUD & Interface Resonance
chimera_rounds.goal: Refine luxury brutalist UI tokens, ensure sub-100ms HUD updates, and polish telemetry streaming.

success_criteria: Identified and prioritized top 3 execution bottlenecks
Quantified memory and latency scaling projections
Zero UI/UX regressions against Tailwind v4 and Luxora Gold standards

template.name: audit
template.title: Forensic Codebase & Security Policy Audit
template.description: Performs 13-gate forensic analysis, taint flow tracking, secret exposure defense, and regression immunity checks.
template.default_objective: Perform zero-trust taint analysis, verify iron gates, and check regression immunity.

chimera_rounds.title: Taint Flow & Perimeter Inspection
chimera_rounds.goal: Analyze Program Dependence Graph (PDG), untrusted ingress sanitization, and secret leaks.

chimera_rounds.title: 13-Gate Forensic Evaluation
chimera_rounds.goal: Independently evaluate diff integrity, test validity, dependency risk, and accessibility baselines.

chimera_rounds.title: Sovereign Ratification Gate
chimera_rounds.goal: Verify Ed25519 cryptographic seals, sign audit verdict, and append to TenantReceiptChain.

success_criteria: Zero unmasked credentials or secret exposure
100% test gate compliance across all security suites
Deterministic cryptographic signature verification

templates.name: research
templates.title: Deep-Dive Domain Investigation & Hypothesis Verification

chimera_rounds.title: Signal Discovery & Foraging

chimera_rounds.title: Synthesis & Deliverable Weaving

Zero unaddressed contradictory evidence
Concrete phased next steps with resource bounds

templates.description: Explores domain sources, discovers clustering overlaps, pressure-tests hypothesis claims, and synthesizes strategic briefs.
templates.default_objective: Investigate target domain architecture, map operational requirements, and verify integration constraints.

chimera_rounds.title: Signal Discovery & Foraging
chimera_rounds.goal: Scan primary documentation, verify citations, and extract high-density structural evidence.

chimera_rounds.title: Hypothesis Stress Testing
chimera_rounds.goal: Cross-examine contradictory claims against historical benchmarks and architectural invariants.

chimera_rounds.title: Synthesis & Deliverable Weaving
chimera_rounds.goal: Distill high-signal synthesis into a bounded actionable brief and next-step execution plan.

success_criteria: >=90% verified source citation coverage
Zero unaddressed contradictory evidence
Concrete phased next steps with resource bounds

templates.name: architecture
templates.title: Zero-Trust System Boundary & Topology Design
templates.description: Designs sovereign component boundaries, interface contracts, resource budgets, and zero-drift fail-soft paths.
templates.default_objective: Design sovereign system boundaries, formalize typed schema contracts, and enforce zero-drift isolation.

chimera_rounds.title: Topology & Interface Mapping
chimera_rounds.goal: Map subsystem components, define unidirectional data flows, and establish isolation boundaries.

chimera_rounds.title: Invariants & Failure Mode Analysis
chimera_rounds.goal: Formalize mathematical proofs, bounded capacity ceilings, and fail-soft degradation trees.

chimera_rounds.title: Typed Schema & Contract Locking
chimera_rounds.goal: Emit RFC 8785 canonical contracts, generate cross-boundary bindings, and pin cryptographic locks.

success_criteria: 100% typed interface boundaries with zero unvalidated inputs
Strict compliance with Rule 7 zero-hotpath bare-metal doctrine
Formal rollback and circuit breaker specifications

templates.name: audit
templates.title: Forensic Codebase & Security Policy Audit
templates.description: Performs 13-gate forensic analysis, taint flow tracking, secret exposure defense, and regression immunity checks.
templates.default_objective: Perform zero-trust taint analysis, verify iron gates, and check regression immunity.

chimera_rounds.title: Taint Flow & Perimeter Inspection
chimera_rounds.goal: Analyze Program Dependence Graph (PDG), untrusted ingress sanitization, and secret leaks.

chimera_rounds.title: 13-Gate Forensic Evaluation
chimera_rounds.goal: Independently evaluate diff integrity, test validity, dependency risk, and accessibility baselines.

chimera_rounds.title: Sovereign Ratification Gate
chimera_rounds.goal: Verify Ed25519 cryptographic seals, sign audit verdict, and append to TenantReceiptChain.

success_criteria: Zero unmasked credentials or secret exposure
100% test gate compliance across all security suites
Deterministic cryptographic signature verification

templates.name: operations
templates.title: Production Deployment & High-Availability Operations
templates.description: Architects zero-downtime deployment choreography, circuit breaker policies, eBPF scarcity controls, and runbooks.
templates.default_objective: Establish production release runbooks, configure scarcity daemon thresholds, and verify circuit breakers.

chimera_rounds.title: Deployment Choreography & Health Checks
chimera_rounds.goal: Define rolling migration sequencing, automated health checks, and Canary verification gates.

chimera_rounds.title: Resource Scarcity & PSI Throttling
chimera_rounds.goal: Configure 8GB hard cap, Samsung S26 Ultra audio slice, and Linux eBPF PSI hysteresis thresholds.

chimera_rounds.title: Bifrost Perimeter & Circuit Breakers
chimera_rounds.goal: Verify mTLS boundaries, Tailscale mesh connectivity, and remote timeout/circuit breaker thresholds.

deliverables: Bifrost Perimeter Health & Circuit Breaker Limits
success_criteria: Sub-second failover and degraded dependency fast-fail
Zero Docker footprint (100% bare-metal systemd/WASM/Rust)
All 6 production Iron Gates confirmed green

templates.name: growth
templates.title: Ecosystem Expansion & Capability Scaling
templates.description: Evaluates cross-node mesh capacity, operator velocity, friction points, and multi-tenant scaling patterns.
templates.default_objective: Scale multi-node mesh capacity, evaluate developer velocity, and streamline onboarding.

chimera_rounds.title: DAG Bottleneck & Flow Analysis
chimera_rounds.goal: Profile task execution graphs, identify serialization bottlenecks, and measure agent latency.

chimera_rounds.title: Multi-Node Mesh Capacity Planning
chimera_rounds.goal: Model workload distribution across Tailscale fleet nodes and evaluate memory headroom scaling.

chimera_rounds.title: Operator HUD & Interface Resonance
chimera_rounds.goal: Refine luxury brutalist UI tokens, ensure sub-100ms HUD updates, and polish telemetry streaming.

success_criteria: Identified and prioritized top 3 execution bottlenecks
Quantified memory and latency scaling projections
Zero UI/UX regressions against Tailwind v4 and Luxora Gold standards
